SELECT
  CAST(SUM(net_sales_cents) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(valid_order_count), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS avg_order_value
  , CAST(SUM(net_sales_cents) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT buyer_count), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS avg_buyer_value
  , CAST(SUM(valid_order_count) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT buyer_count), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS purchase_frequency
  , CAST(SUM(refund_cents) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(payment_cents), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS refund_amount_rate
  , CAST(SUM(cancelled_order_count) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(order_count), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS cancel_rate
  , CAST(SUM(refund_order_count) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(paid_order_count), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS refund_order_rate
  , CAST(SUM(discount_cents) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(gross_cents), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS discount_rate
  , CAST(SUM(valid_order_items) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(valid_order_count), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS items_per_order
FROM (
  SELECT
    channel AS order__channel
    , CASE WHEN order_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS order_count
    , CASE WHEN case when status = 'paid' then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS paid_order_count
    , CASE WHEN case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS valid_order_count
    , CASE WHEN case when status = 'cancelled' then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS cancelled_order_count
    , CASE WHEN case when status = 'paid' and refund_cents > 0 then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS refund_order_count
    , case when status = 'paid' then paid_cents else 0 end AS payment_cents
    , case when status = 'paid' then refund_cents else 0 end AS refund_cents
    , case when status = 'paid' then paid_cents - refund_cents else 0 end AS net_sales_cents
    , case when status = 'paid' then gross_cents else 0 end AS gross_cents
    , case when status = 'paid' then gross_cents - paid_cents else 0 end AS discount_cents
    , case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then member_id end AS buyer_count
    , case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then quantity else 0 end AS valid_order_items
  FROM "data"."main"."orders_enriched" orders_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_15
WHERE order__channel in ('小程序')
answer: 统计范围：青禾客户数据范围内，2026年8月1日至9月1日、小程序渠道；未按门店分组。人数按CRM会员账户计数，金额由分换算为元展示。结果：有效订单均额37.46元/单；购买会员人均消费37.46元/账户；购买频次1.00单/账户；退款金额占比22.33%；取消率6.25%；退款订单率13.33%；优惠率4.71%；单均商品件数1.15件/单。口径分别为：净销售额/有效订单数、净销售额/购买会员账户数、有效订单数/购买会员账户数、退款金额/实付金额、取消订单数/创建订单数、退款订单数/支付订单数、优惠金额/支付订单原价金额、有效订单商品件数/有效订单数。数据为合成测试库，以上指标均有返回数值，未出现零值或未定义情况。
question: 请同时列出2026年8月青禾优选小程序渠道的有效订单均额、购买会员人均消费、购买频次、退款金额占比、取消率、退款订单率、优惠率、单均商品件数。
